intents.title: Deploy the 5-object data model for match crew scheduling

outcome.summary: All 5 custom objects exist in the org with their relationships, picklists, and rules — ready for the scheduling logic and agent to build on top of.

intents.build_target:
- Create Team__c: Name (standard), City__c (Text 100)
- Create Stadium__c: Name__c (Text 100), City__c (Text 100), Capacity__c (Number)
- Create Staff_Member__c: Name (standard), Role__c (Picklist: Ground Staff / Commentator / Camera Operator), Is_Active__c (Checkbox, default true)
- Create Match__c: Home_Team__c (Lookup → Team__c), Away_Team__c (Lookup → Team__c), Stadium__c (Lookup → Stadium__c), Start_DateTime__c (DateTime, required), End_DateTime__c (DateTime, required), Status__c (Picklist: Draft / Staffing / Set, default Draft)
- Create Match_Assignment__c: Match__c (Master-Detail → Match__c), Staff_Member__c (Lookup → Staff_Member__c), Role__c (Picklist: same values as Staff_Member__c.Role__c)
- Validation rule on Match_Assignment__c: block any edit (insert/update/delete) when parent Match__c.Status__c = 'Set'. Rule name: No_Edit_On_Set_Match
- Duplicate rule on Match_Assignment__c: unique constraint on (Match__c, Staff_Member__c) — one person per match
- Standard Lightning page layouts for all 5 objects (no custom LWC required)
- Permission set Match_Organiser: Read/Create/Edit on all 5 objects + Agentforce surface access
- Permission set Match_Admin: full CRUD on Team__c, Stadium__c, Staff_Member__c
guardrails: Must not use a Lookup on Match_Assignment → Match — it must be Master-Detail so cascade-delete works.
Must not make Start_DateTime__c or End_DateTime__c optional — both are required for overlap detection.
Must not add a Capacity or staffing-threshold field to Match__c — thresholds are hardcoded in Apex for Phase 1.
Must not create any Apex triggers on these objects — all automation is invocable-method-based.
out_of_scope: Must not create any Agentforce Topics or Actions in this intent (handled by INT-003).
Must not write any Apex classes in this intent (handled by INT-002).
Must not create page layout customisations beyond standard layouts.
intents.acceptance: An Admin user opens Setup, navigates to Object Manager, and sees all 5 custom objects listed. They open Match__c and confirm Start_DateTime__c and End_DateTime__c are both required DateTime fields. They create a Match_Assignment__c record for Match 'Test Match 1' with Staff Member 'Alice'. They attempt to create a second Match_Assignment__c for the same match and same staff member — the duplicate rule blocks it with a clear error. They set the parent Match__c.Status__c to 'Set' and attempt to edit the assignment — the validation rule blocks it.

intents.title: Detect staff availability and stadium conflicts for a match window

outcome.summary: Given a match ID and a requested role, the system returns the staff members who are available (active, correct role, no time-overlapping assignment) and flags if the stadium is already booked in that window.

intents.build_target:
- Apex class StaffAvailabilityChecker with @InvocableMethod annotation
- Input: matchId (Id), requestedRole (String)
- Logic step 1 — stadium conflict check: query Match__c WHERE Stadium__c = [match's stadium] AND Id != matchId AND Start_DateTime__c < [match's End_DateTime__c] AND End_DateTime__c > [match's Start_DateTime__c] AND Status__c != 'Set'. If any rows returned, return a stadium-conflict error message; do not proceed to staff check.
- Logic step 2 — staff availability: query all Staff_Member__c WHERE Role__c = requestedRole AND Is_Active__c = true. Then query Match_Assignment__c WHERE Match__r.Start_DateTime__c < [match's End_DateTime__c] AND Match__r.End_DateTime__c > [match's Start_DateTime__c] AND Match__r.Id != matchId AND Match__r.Status__c != 'Set' to get conflicted staff IDs. Return the difference (available = all active staff of role minus conflicted IDs).
- Touching-times boundary: use strict less-than (<) not less-than-or-equal — two matches where B starts exactly when A ends are a conflict.
- Output: List<StaffAvailabilityChecker.Result> where Result has: availableStaff (List<String> of names), stadiumConflict (Boolean), errorMessage (String)
- Apex test class StaffAvailabilityCheckerTest with scenarios: (a) no conflict — returns available staff, (b) touching times — B starts exactly when A ends — returns conflict, (c) full overlap — returns conflict, (d) stadium booked by another match in same window — returns stadium-conflict error, (e) no active staff of requested role — returns empty list
guardrails: Must not modify any records — this method is read-only.
Must not exclude Set matches from the stadium conflict check — a Set match still occupies the stadium.
Must not use Status__c != 'Set' in the staff conflict query for a different reason — the intent is to exclude assignments on already-confirmed matches from blocking availability.
out_of_scope: Must not insert or update any records (handled by INT-003).
Must not check crew minimums or threshold counts (handled by INT-004).
intents.acceptance: A developer runs StaffAvailabilityCheckerTest with all 5 test scenarios. All pass at >75% coverage. In the org: for Match 3 (pre-seeded with 2 Camera Operators already assigned), calling StaffAvailabilityChecker with matchId=Match3 and requestedRole='Camera Operator' returns only the Camera Operators who have no other overlapping assignment — the 2 already assigned on Match 3 are not in the available list (they're already assigned, not conflicted). A test call with a role that has a stadium conflict returns stadiumConflict=true and an appropriate errorMessage.

intents.title: Assign a staff member to a match and advance match status

outcome.summary: A staff member is assigned to a match for a specific role. The match status moves from Draft to Staffing on the first assignment. The assignment is blocked if the staff member is unavailable.

intents.build_target:
- Apex class StaffAssigner with @InvocableMethod annotation
- Input: matchId (Id), staffMemberId (Id), role (String)
- Logic step 1 — re-validate availability inline: call StaffAvailabilityChecker for matchId + role. If the requested staff member is not in the returned available list (or a stadium conflict exists), return an error message and abort without writing.
- Logic step 2 — insert Match_Assignment__c: Match__c = matchId, Staff_Member__c = staffMemberId, Role__c = role
- Logic step 3 — status transition: if Match__c.Status__c = 'Draft', update it to 'Staffing' (first assignment triggers this; subsequent assignments leave status as-is)
- Output: StaffAssigner.Result with: success (Boolean), message (String — confirmation or error)
- Apex test class StaffAssignerTest with scenarios: (a) successful assignment on a Draft match — inserts record, status moves to Staffing, (b) successful assignment on a Staffing match — inserts record, status unchanged, (c) conflict detected inline — no record inserted, error returned, (d) duplicate assignment (same match + staff) — duplicate rule fires, error returned gracefully
guardrails: Must re-validate availability inline even though the agent already called StaffAvailabilityChecker — race conditions between the check and the write are real.
Must not set Status__c to 'Set' — that is MatchConfirmer's responsibility (INT-004).
Must not bypass the duplicate rule — let the database enforce it and catch the exception gracefully.
out_of_scope: Must not check crew minimums or confirm the match (handled by INT-004).
Must not remove or update existing assignments.
intents.acceptance: Developer runs StaffAssignerTest — all 4 scenarios pass. In the org: assign Staff Member 'Bob (Ground Staff)' to Match 3 (currently Draft). Match 3 status moves to Staffing and a Match_Assignment__c record exists for Bob on Match 3. Assign Bob to Match 3 again — duplicate rule error returned, no duplicate record created. Call with a staff member who has a conflicting assignment on another match in the same window — conflict detected, no record inserted.

intents.title: Confirm a match when minimum crew thresholds are met

outcome.summary: When an Organiser requests match confirmation, the system checks crew minimums per role. If all thresholds are met, the match is locked as Set and a crew summary is returned. If not, the missing crew count per role is returned.

intents.build_target:
- Apex class MatchConfirmer with @InvocableMethod annotation
- Input: matchId (Id)
- Hardcoded thresholds as private static final Integer constants: GROUND_STAFF_MIN = 4, COMMENTATOR_MIN = 2, CAMERA_OPERATOR_MIN = 3
- Logic: query Match_Assignment__c GROUP BY Role__c for the match, count per role
- Check each role against its threshold. Collect failures as a list of 'Need X more [Role]' strings.
- If all pass: update Match__c.Status__c = 'Set', return crew summary (count + names per role)
- If any fail: do NOT update status, return the list of threshold failures
- Output: MatchConfirmer.Result with: confirmed (Boolean), message (String), crewSummary (String — formatted list when confirmed)
- Apex test class MatchConfirmerTest with scenarios: (a) all thresholds met — status flips to Set, crew summary returned, (b) Ground Staff below threshold — correct error message, status unchanged, (c) multiple roles below threshold — all failures listed, (d) call on already-Set match — returns already confirmed message, no re-update
guardrails: Must not use Custom Metadata for thresholds in Phase 1 — hardcoded constants only.
Must not flip status to Set unless ALL three role thresholds pass in the same invocation.
Must not allow status to move back from Set — the validation rule on Match_Assignment__c handles this, but this class must not attempt to set Status__c to anything other than 'Set'.
out_of_scope: Must not remove assignments or modify crew.
Must not send notifications or emails — Phase 1 is agent-conversation only.
intents.acceptance: Developer runs MatchConfirmerTest — all 4 scenarios pass. In the org: assign exactly 4 Ground Staff, 2 Commentators, and 3 Camera Operators to Match 3. Call MatchConfirmer for Match 3. Match 3 Status__c updates to 'Set'. The returned crew summary lists all 9 assigned staff by role. Attempt to edit a Match_Assignment__c on Match 3 — validation rule blocks it. Call MatchConfirmer with only 3 Ground Staff assigned — status stays Staffing, error message says 'Need 1 more Ground Staff'.

intents.title: Configure the Agentforce agent for match crew scheduling

outcome.summary: An Organiser can ask the agent in plain English to list matches, check who's available, assign crew, and confirm a match. The agent always asks for confirmation before assigning, and politely declines out-of-scope requests.

intents.build_target:
- Create Agentforce Topic: Match_Operations
- Topic description: 'You help the Organiser assign crew to upcoming matches. Always ask for confirmation before assigning. Never remove assignments unless asked. If asked about anything outside match crew scheduling, politely decline.'
- Action 1 — Get Teams: backed by Apex @InvocableMethod GetTeamsAction. Returns list of team names.
- Action 2 — Get Upcoming Matches: backed by Apex @InvocableMethod GetUpcomingMatchesAction. Returns match name, teams, date/time, stadium, status for matches with Status__c IN ('Draft','Staffing').
- Action 3 — Check Staff Availability: backed by StaffAvailabilityChecker (INT-002). Inputs: matchId, requestedRole.
- Action 4 — Assign Staff: backed by StaffAssigner (INT-003). Inputs: matchId, staffMemberId, role. Agent instruction: 'Before calling Assign Staff, state the name and role of the staff member you are about to assign and ask the Organiser: Shall I assign [Name] as [Role]? Only call Assign Staff after the Organiser confirms.'
- Action 5 — Confirm Match: backed by MatchConfirmer (INT-004). Input: matchId.
- Create Apex classes GetTeamsAction and GetUpcomingMatchesAction (simple SOQL — no overlap logic needed)
- Assign Match_Organiser permission set to the demo user in the org
guardrails: Must not call Assign Staff without an explicit Organiser confirmation in the same conversation turn.
Must not attempt to remove or edit existing assignments — if asked, decline politely.
Must not respond to questions outside match crew scheduling (ticketing, scores, payroll, schedule generation).
GetUpcomingMatchesAction must not return Set matches — the Organiser has no actions to take on a confirmed match.
out_of_scope: Must not build a Slack or Experience Cloud channel — internal Lightning app only.
Must not build an un-assign action in Phase 1.
Must not make crew thresholds configurable via the agent — Phase 1 only.
intents.acceptance: The demo user opens the internal Salesforce app and the Match Operations Agent is available. They type: 'Show me upcoming matches.' The agent returns the list of Draft/Staffing matches. They type: 'Who is available as a camera operator for Match 3?' The agent calls Check Staff Availability and returns a list of available Camera Operators by name. They type: 'Assign Carlos as camera operator for Match 3.' The agent responds: 'Shall I assign Carlos as Camera Operator for Match 3?' The Organiser says yes. The agent calls Assign Staff and confirms the assignment. The Organiser types: 'Book me a hotel for the stadium.' The agent declines politely and stays on topic.

open_questions.question: Should GetUpcomingMatchesAction filter by a date range (e.g. next 30 days), or return all non-Set matches regardless of date?

intents.title: Deploy all metadata and seed the demo dataset

outcome.summary: The full build is deployed to astroNewOrgOne and a realistic demo dataset exists — the Organiser can run the 4-step demo flow immediately, and the demo can be reset and repeated cleanly.

intents.build_target:
- SFDX project with all metadata: custom objects (5), fields, validation rules, duplicate rules, Apex classes (5: StaffAvailabilityChecker, StaffAssigner, MatchConfirmer, GetTeamsAction, GetUpcomingMatchesAction), Apex test classes (4), permission sets (2), Agentforce topic + 5 actions
- Deployment sequence (order matters): (1) custom objects + fields + rules, (2) Apex classes + test classes, (3) permission sets, (4) Agentforce topic + actions
- Anonymous Apex seed data script:
  - 5 Teams: Mumbai Indians, Chennai Super Kings, Delhi Capitals, Royal Challengers Bangalore, Kolkata Knight Riders
  - 3 Stadiums: Wankhede Stadium (Mumbai), MA Chidambaram Stadium (Chennai), Narendra Modi Stadium (Ahmedabad)
  - 18 Staff Members: 6 Ground Staff, 6 Commentators, 6 Camera Operators (all Is_Active__c = true)
  - 5 Matches: Match 1-4 spread across different stadiums and dates; Match 3 is the demo focus match at Wankhede Stadium on a specific future date
  - Pre-seed 3 assignments on Match 3: 2 Camera Operators already assigned, so Action 3 shows realistic availability during the demo
  - At least 1 staff member per role has an overlapping assignment on a different match (to show availability filtering)
- Assign Match_Organiser permission set to the demo user: sf org assign permset -n Match_Organiser --target-org astroNewOrgOne
- Anonymous Apex reset script (run before each demo session):
  delete [SELECT Id FROM Match_Assignment__c];
  List<Match__c> matches = [SELECT Id, Status__c FROM Match__c];
  for (Match__c m : matches) { m.Status__c = 'Draft'; }
  update matches;
  System.debug('Reset complete.');
- Post-deploy smoke test checklist: agent active in Agent Studio, all 5 actions linked, demo flow runs end-to-end once
guardrails: Must deploy objects before Apex (Apex references the objects) and Apex before the agent actions (actions reference the Apex classes).
Must not seed real personal data — all seed data is fictional.
Must not run the reset script during deployment — it's for pre-demo use only.
out_of_scope: Must not set up CI/CD pipeline — single deploy, Phase 1 only.
Must not migrate any real data.
intents.acceptance: sf project deploy start completes with 0 errors and 0 warnings. All 4 Apex test classes pass with >75% coverage. The demo user can open the Salesforce app, find the Match Operations Agent, and complete the 4-step demo flow: (1) list matches, (2) check Camera Operator availability for Match 3 (sees 4 available, 2 already assigned), (3) assign one Camera Operator, (4) attempt to confirm — agent reports how many more crew are still needed. The reset script runs in under 5 seconds and leaves Teams, Stadiums, Staff Members, and Matches intact.

open_questions.question: What are the specific dates/times for the 5 demo matches? They need to be in the future at demo time.
